method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi and read every ask page in full (listening 2-6 and 8-11, composing 3-11); used PyMuPDF clips at 250-350 dpi on every glyph in doubt: the Q1 lead-in "A Major K488" (no comma, p2) against Excerpt 3(ii) "A Major, K488" (comma, p3), the bullets at the left margin of each lead-in (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6), the curly apostrophes in "When I’m Sixty-four" / "When I’m sixty-four?", the Q3 lyric lines (no full stop after lines 2 and 5), the Q4(v) technique list ("Techniques" then three printed bullets), the Q5 heading "Q. 5 Irish Music" (no full stop) and its bullet line, "Excerpt 1" / "Excerpt 2" / "Excerpt 3" (no full stop) and "A verse from Galway Bay.", "Q. 6 Aural Skills." (full stop) and "Saint-Saens" (no accent), en dashes in bars 1–8 / 9–16 / 1–15, and the em dashes in the composing Q4 cadence lines (I—IV—V etc., 300 dpi). Decoded the shifted-font lines of the text layer (+29 code shift, ¿ = "fi", À = "fl") and checked them against the render: listening p5 lyric 4 "Give me your answer, fill in a form, mine forever more.", p6 "Techniques • inversion • canon • augmentation", p8 "• Answer the questions on each excerpt.". The rest of both text layers is clean Times New Roman and agrees with the render. The "F" in composing Q5 "scale of F major" is set in OpusChords but prints a plain capital F with no sign. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets as "\n• ", " • " between printed composing bullets, a space for unbulleted lines, tick boxes as "□ "), compared each file string exactly, and checked the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings (U+2022 bullet, U+2013 en dash, U+2014 em dash, U+2019 apostrophe, U+25A1 box; no double or trailing spaces). Addresses checked against the printed numbering: parts are numbered afresh under each excerpt in Q1, Q5 and Q6, and Q6 Excerpts 2-4 carry no part numbers; all 49 addresses match. Convention noted, not counted as a difference: Section A Q2(b) begins "USING THIS RHYTHM, ..." without the bullet the page prints before that line. The file's notes record this as deliberate (the card joins it after the "(b)" label), and the 2017 and 2018 Ordinary second readings passed the same form. Q2(b) has no grid (shared card c-a-q2, grid on (a)). The file has no readFromPage entries. Elective: none at Ordinary.
